summary: Both inputs always contain two coordinates on one fixed 8 by 8 board, so the complete domain has only 4,096 ordered cell pairs and cannot support honest asymptotic scaling tiers.

workload_bound.source_constraint: start.length == target.length == 2 and every coordinate is in [0, 7]

replacement_checks.evidence: The remotely accepted implementation reads exactly four coordinates, computes two coordinate-sum parities, and performs one equality comparison regardless of the selected cells.

Both packaged sources were compared against an independent BFS over (x, y, move-parity) states for all 64 possible starts and all 64 possible targets, covering all 4,096 legal ordered pairs, plus the authored cases.
